title: A Drive save whose token lapses between upload and verify now says sign in again, not heal
evidence: Closed 2026-11-14: fixed by e8555ac81; ios/engine/cloud-adapters.ts:251 maps a 401 whose refresh was skipped to 'unreachable', and :151 sets refreshNext so the next call forces a fresh token. Was: Found at the checkpoint 3 look-back of S57 (F1). ios/engine/cloud-adapters.ts:66-75 refreshOn401 no longer runs a 401 again when the failure is marked may-have-landed (:72, mayHaveLanded from packages/health-core/src/write-refusal.ts:23), so a retry's answer never replaces the mark and S57's put-back cannot fire over a cloud that holds the write. Google Drive's adapter marks every failure after it sent the upload, the verify read included (packages/health-core/src/drive-rest.ts:320-323 uncertain keeps the 401 status; the verify block :538-547). So when the access token lapses between the PATCH and the verify read, the save fails with a marked 401, and failureKind maps any 401 to 'sign-in' (cloud-adapters.ts:225-227): Swift shows 'needs you to sign in again' (ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/SyncProblem.swift:45) though a fresh token would work. Before S57 the verify read ran once more on a forced refresh and the save healed. Fix: heal on the next call without retrying the write, keeping the mark (design pending). US-25 AC11; US-11 AC3b
